digest.component_or_area: bridge state store format and versioning
propositions: Four committed format changes to .bridge_state require architectural documentation: A1 baseline_advanced_at deletion, A2 last_get_pass relocation to get_rotation.json, A3 scalar baseline normalization, and A4-2 prev_snapshot narrowing to key set.
Mixed-version protocol must read chronological max(new, legacy) and write both formats until direct deployment evidence confirms A2-2 cutover, then scrub legacy; first-wins ordering is unsafe.

A2-2 deployment gate requires A2-1 merge, successful descendant reconcile-bridge.yml run, explicitly refreshed host probe with no older process, and old/new-writer self-healing oracle—elapsed time is insufficient without pass-record version stamp.
Rollback boundaries differ by change: A2-1 and A3 are fully reversible; A2-2 supports rollback only to A2-1-or-newer; A4-2 requires recorded forward and reverse corpus evidence.

Bridge state remains committed on-branch because ephemeral GitHub runners require durable state; epic 6c9c rejected off-branch relocation; measurements show 12.79 KB to 1.74 KB marginal cost after A1, with 218/399 identical prev key sets per session log 1cb6-d553-6565-49b4.
